full_name: Sonia C. Gomez | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 History Joy Foundation Fellow Santa Clara University
bio: Sonia C. Gomez is a 20th-century US historian and the author of Picture Bride, War Bride: The Role of Marriage in Shaping Japanese America (NYU Press, 2024), which won the Organization of American Historians’ 2025 Mary Nickliss Prize.
